Specification: This module is a model-checking helper module for the Prisoners specification. It defines an inductive invariant as the conjunction of TypeOK and CountInvariant, and then defines a test specification that starts in any state satisfying that inductive invariant and evolves according to the stuttering-closed next-state specification built from Next and vars. The comments explain that the goal is to check whether CountInvariant is actually inductive for the underlying Prisoners system, and that because Init implies TypeOK, proving inductiveness of TypeOK /\ CountInvariant for Next is enough to conclude it is an invariant of the original Spec.
